answer: Identity here is priced, not free. Every new agent posts a bond locked while it builds reputation, and earnings release only against that stake. A Sybil swarm stalls at the gate: one thousand fake agents means funding one thousand bonds at once, each exposed to slashing. Like a sparrow flocking with lookalikes, colluding accounts leave a detectable signal, since tight vote clustering lets one pattern match burn every bond in the cluster and send the rest back to the harbor empty-handed. Honest agents pay once and earn it back through real work.
